name: Multiplayer
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Online multiplayer, first step: a Multiplayer item in the title's main menu, under Load Game, whose pages (the game's own menus) connect to an OpenRAC server, find or create a party or join one by its code, or play without a server with Direct connect (host directly, or join a host by its address), and show the lobby with your name. Nothing of the game is played together yet.

settings.name: Server
settings.description: The OpenRAC server to connect to, as host:port (7770 when no port is given).

settings.name: Name
settings.description: Your name in multiplayer: 3 to 16 letters, digits or underscores. Defaults to the launcher's Multiplayer name.
